functions.name: cancel-prediction
functions.description: Request cancellation of a running prediction and return its provider-reported current state.

predictionId.description: Opaque identifier of the prediction to cancel.

FunctionInput_replicate_cancelprediction.description: The prediction whose cancellation is requested.

logs.description: Model logs when returned, including empty text.

error.description: Recorded model failure text or null.

output.description: Current JSON output, retaining null and any partial output or file URLs.

status.description: Provider-reported current state; do not assume canceled merely because the request succeeded.

metrics.description: Native provider metric map; total_time and predict_time are seconds, other values retain provider meaning.

modelId.description: Model identifier in owner/name form.

deadline.description: Automatic-cancellation instant in UTC Z or null; omitted if unavailable.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC Z with source precision retained.

startedAt.description: Execution-start instant in UTC Z or null; omitted if unavailable.

streamUrl.description: SSE URL if present; no stream is opened.

versionId.description: Version identifier or literal hidden for an unversioned official model.

completedAt.description: Completion and upload instant in UTC Z or null; omitted if unavailable.

dataRemoved.description: Whether output data has been deleted, independently of cancellation.

FunctionOutput_replicate_cancelpredictio.description: The provider-reported prediction immediately after the cancellation request, without polling.

tags.instructions: Get predictionId from `create-prediction` or `list-predictions`; inspect `get-prediction` if its state is uncertain. Cancellation stops work rather than deleting the prediction record and cannot resume the same job. Use `get-prediction` afterward if the returned state is still active. No refund or immediate cancellation is promised.

functions.name: cancel-training

trainingId.description: Opaque identifier of the training to cancel.

output.description: Current training result, null or omitted if unavailable.

status.description: Actual returned lifecycle state; success of the request does not itself establish canceled.

modelId.description: Source model identifier in owner/name form.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC Z retaining fractional precision.

startedAt.description: Start instant in UTC Z or null; omitted if unavailable.

completedAt.description: Completion instant in UTC Z or null; omitted if unavailable.

FunctionOutput_replicate_canceltraining.description: The provider-reported training state returned by the cancellation request.

tags.instructions: Use a trainingId from `create-training` or `list-trainings`. Inspect `get-training` if state is uncertain. Cancellation stops work; it does not delete the source or destination model and does not offer resumption of the same job. Use `get-training` afterward if it still appears active. FunctionInput_replicate_createdeployment.description: Model version, hardware, and explicit scaling bounds for a new deployment.

name.description: Deployment name within the owner's namespace.

model.description: Current release model in owner/name form; omitted if not returned.

functions.name: create-deployment-prediction
functions.description: Start a prediction using a deployment's current model and return its initial or briefly awaited state. Predictions may incur model execution charges.

input.description: Model-specific input values as a JSON object; files use HTTP URLs or data URLs. Keys follow the selected model's input schema.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for output before returning; zero returns without requesting a wait. Does not bound prediction lifetime.

cancelAfterSeconds.description: Optional maximum prediction lifetime in seconds from creation, including queue time; omission uses provider behavior without an explicit deadline.

FunctionInput_replicate_createdeployment.description: Deployment and model inputs for starting one prediction, with optional waiting and lifetime limits.

id.description: Opaque prediction ID used for subsequent lookup.

logs.description: Model log text; omitted if absent.

get.description: API URL for current prediction state.

cancel.description: API URL for cancellation; a link alone does not perform cancellation.

stream.description: SSE output URL when the model supports streaming; omitted otherwise.

urls.description: Links for viewing and operating on this prediction.

error.description: Model failure explanation, or null when none is reported.

input.description: Provider-reported model input values with their model-defined keys.

output.description: Model-specific JSON output, including null while unavailable; a value here does not by itself imply success.

source.description: Provider-reported creation source; omitted if absent.

status.description: Prediction lifecycle state; aborted means terminated before running, canceled means canceled during its lifetime.

metrics.description: Provider-defined metric names and JSON values; total_time, when present, is seconds. No units are inferred for other keys.

deadline.description: Automatic cancellation instant in UTC; omitted when not returned.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC with fractional precision retained.

startedAt.description: Model execution start in UTC; omitted if not yet available.

versionId.description: Model version ID, or the literal hidden for a model without exposed versions.

deployment.description: Provider-reported deployment name; omitted if absent.

completedAt.description: Completion and output-upload instant in UTC; omitted if not available.

dataRemoved.description: Whether prediction output data has been deleted.

FunctionOutput_replicate_createdeploymen.description: Created prediction state, model-defined values, lifecycle timestamps, and follow-up links.

tags.instructions: Use a deployment ID from `list-deployments` or `get-deployment`, and obtain model-specific input names from the model's API documentation. Supply ordinary JSON values; file inputs use HTTP or data URLs. The tool starts a new billable prediction and does not guarantee completion. Use the returned ID with `get-prediction` to check progress. Do not replay an uncertain creation: it can start another prediction. Waiting is optional and capped at 60 seconds.

status.description: Current job lifecycle state, not a delivery guarantee.

metrics.description: Provider metric map retaining keys; total_time and predict_time are seconds when present, other values retain provider meaning.
